analysis.executiveSummary: In a 16-team dynasty league where Corgi Loaf Baking Co. is pursuing a 2026 championship, trading DeVonta Smith for Tee Higgins addresses an immediate short-term availability risk caused by Smith's lingering hamstring injury and Philadelphia's quarterback transition to Tanner McKee. Factoring in that trade partner All Hail King Jesus (Hofer) is projected at a 2-5 record and sliding into a retool/rebuild mindset rather than an elite title-favorite lock, King Jesus has strong motivation to cash out on an expiring asset like Tee Higgins for younger foundational pieces and draft capital. However, attaching an unneeded 2nd-round pick on top of DeVonta Smith remains an overpay. The refined assessment integrates Hofer's 2-5 record to make a 1:1 swap or value-optimized package exceptionally realistic.
